byteward.sentence: Corvid announced the RV-90 on Monday, its new flagship graphics card for desktop PCs.
The card is built on Nocturne, Corvid's new graphics architecture.
It ships with 24 GB of GDDR7 memory.
The chip is made on a 3 nm process.
Corvid says the RV-90 is twice as fast as last year's RV-80 at ray tracing.

launch-desk.sentence: Corvid has launched the RV-90, its new flagship graphics card.
Under the hood is Nocturne, the company's new graphics architecture.
The card carries 24 GB of GDDR7 memory.
Corvid claims the RV-90 doubles the RV-80's ray-tracing performance.

frametime.sentence: Corvid revealed the RV-90 today, its new flagship graphics card.
At 4K, the RV-90 ran 38% faster than the RV-80 in our testing.
Across our ray-traced games, it averaged 142 frames per second at 1440p.
Our power meter showed the card drawing 320 W under load.
Its 24 GB of GDDR7 memory leaves plenty of headroom at high resolutions.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: Corvid unveiled the RV-90 on Monday, its new flagship graphics card.
The card uses Corvid's new Nocturne architecture.
Corvid makes the chip on a 3 nm process.
Corvid has set the price at $899.
Cards arrive in stores on December 10.
In our benchmarks, it was 38 percent faster than the RV-80 at 4K.
We measured 320 W of power draw under load.
Corvid recommends an 850 W power supply for the card.
Under sustained load, the GPU ran at 84 °C.
At launch, only 14 games support the card's frame generation feature.
